native_sql_predicate_map.subject: original journal columns and once-only body
native_sql_predicate_map.native_predicate: OLD.operation IS 'v2:session.control'; OLD/NEW principal,project,operation,key,request_hash,status,headers,created_at compare with IS (and typeof plus hex(CAST(... AS BLOB)) for exact bytes); only body differs. CAST(body AS TEXT) must be valid strict JSON input; old ACK/new COMPLETED; never ACK->ACK, final->final even no-op, reverse or unrelated method. Check original retained bytes and exact final bytes.
native_sql_predicate_map.limit: JSON parsing/type subgate does not prove UTF8/JCS/full schema; use CASE to fail closed on invalid JSON and NULL. No WHEN NOT(expr) nullable bypass.

native_sql_predicate_map.subject: CANCEL envelope/response finite outer shapes
native_sql_predicate_map.native_predicate: On decoded JSON text: json_type(object); json_each key-set EXACT count9 for envelope and response (required names from frozen schema); every key once; no unknowns. CANCEL payload exact3 action,target_id,reason with string types/action=CANCEL. Command/session/client/project identity strings nonempty; writer_epoch/expected_revision JSON integer>=1. Response protocol/method/command/session match original; ACK PendingResult exact fields; COMPLETED ControlResult exact7 fields, three true booleans and nested snapshot type object; error/error_code must be explicit JSON null, not missing. Nullable fields use json_type IS null-literal vs SQL NULL deliberately.
native_sql_predicate_map.limit: Envelope stored in private base64 first needs trusted decode; nested SessionSnapshot has external refs, date-time, arrays and input/read validation differences. Enumerating these outer fields is not full schema.

native_sql_predicate_map.subject: duplicate JSON keys
native_sql_predicate_map.native_predicate: After guarded json_valid, traverse json_tree(document); for object parents GROUP BY parent,key HAVING count(*)<>1 for present property groups (detect duplicates count>1); use decoded keys/collation BINARY, including escaped aliases, nested objects. Arrays counted/indexed separately. Exact key membership with json_each.
native_sql_predicate_map.limit: This is a proposed duplicate-key predicate requiring pinned SQLite adversarial tests, not executed here. json_valid alone accepts duplicate names; SQLite normalization/json() is not RFC8785. Unicode surrogate/invalidUTF8 strictness needs Go.

native_sql_predicate_map.subject: private headers
native_sql_predicate_map.native_predicate: Header SQLite TEXT, length(CAST(headers AS BLOB))<=1398200; strict outer JSON object exact3 string names schema/encoding/raw_envelope_base64; constants and base64 text length<=1398104. OLD.headers equals NEW.headers exactly and binds original identity locator.
native_sql_predicate_map.limit: Current builtins provide neither the approved strict base64 decoder/roundtrip nor ContentHash/JCS/SHA256. Character/padding checks alone cannot establish decoded UTF8 envelope or unused bits. Do not silently parse headers as HTTP headers or allow session.create derived SID for CANCEL.

native_sql_predicate_map.subject: identity and command bindings
native_sql_predicate_map.native_predicate: Unique global identity principal+command_id, protocol2, project, method=session.control, operation v2:session.control, request_hash equality with journal and witness. Unique original control_request_id; original SID matches CANCEL SID. Deferred FK locator references original journal. Immutable original scope/client/epoch/revision/target belong admission.
native_sql_predicate_map.limit: Equality of same supplied hashes does not recompute original ContentHash; current head/latest Session never repairs a missing original envelope.

native_sql_predicate_map.subject: complete witness group
native_sql_predicate_map.native_predicate: Exactly one root ADMITTED and unique typed member rows for complete sorted unique task set; member count/set equality against original pre-mutation Goal-membership query or exact target Run.task_id. Every member has identical principal/project/command/request/group locator; no extra or omitted task via two-way NOT EXISTS. Every FINALIZED member references its exact ADMITTED row and variant identity, no copies from other commands. Phase/root/member cardinality must support Goal including tasks without Session.
native_sql_predicate_map.limit: To independently check original complete membership, insert ADMITTED at pre-mutation state, not reconstruct later and not compare only self-reported membership_hash. Historical proof cannot query current active_run_id.

native_sql_predicate_map.subject: Task/Run/dispatch/effect/queue relational anchors
native_sql_predicate_map.native_predicate: Join exact domain_versions project/kind/id/revision and typed epoch, Task/Goal original refs, dispatch manifest/key/identity and historical observation artifact ref. At finalization reject any latest resource_effect state PREPARED/STARTED/UNKNOWN, missing/gapped history, changed request/reservation key; latest key determined by exact sequence, not any older terminal row. Original generation must exist when queued; all commands through admitted accepted_through have terminal CONSUMED/DROPPED with complete same-generation receipt chains; required clear/abort/idle facts and native cleanup refs match exact Run/epoch/process; restore_fenced or missing source facts refuse live finalization.
native_sql_predicate_map.limit: SQL can test stored rows; it cannot observe OS child cleanup or SDK completion itself, compute missing hashes, or turn an absent generation into evidence. Trusted producers and content validation remain required.

native_sql_predicate_map.subject: DELETE/REPLACE/UPSERT guards
native_sql_predicate_map.native_predicate: Protect witness UPDATE/DELETE always; BEFORE INSERT rejects all existing PK AND every unique alternative collision, independent of recursive_triggers. Controls freeze authority/membership/original once set; final_response once only and final state monotonic. Protected original CANCEL journal DELETE rejected; BEFORE INSERT blocks conflicting original PK and protected global principal/command locator. Guard UPSERT UPDATE through same exact transition (and disallow conflict-driven replacement entirely); no INSERT OR IGNORE success interpreted as write. All guards RAISE(ABORT), caller verifies RowsAffected.
native_sql_predicate_map.limit: An attacker able to drop triggers or rewrite every trusted anchor is outside in-file consistency guarantees. New guards must cover deletion/replacement of the exact referenced anchor rows, with legitimate monotonic producer updates retained; if required trigger coverage conflicts with original runtime writes, stop and scope the caller, not weaken it.

D01_transaction_and_deferred_closure: T0 After handler freeze: strict original raw envelope retained; actual authenticated principal and writer/session/project CAS; global identity lookup before ordinary CAS preserves exact replay. New identity reservation stays before business SAVEPOINT. F08 never invokes the session.create derived-SID exception for session.control.

Read real existing Session/queue/Run/dispatch stages. Recommended design revision: insert immutable ADMITTED root+member records now, with deferred journal/identity FKs; no immediate requirement for a journal ACK that does not yet exist. Request raw/envelope/semantic hash and original pre-state frozen here.

T2 ADMITTED no longer invents a not-yet-known original_response_hash. Its journal locator/request_hash is frozen; original response bytes are later single-assigned in existing control.original_response and the sole journal. FINALIZED binds both original and final bytes/hash. This explicit schema-design change requires independent approval; it is not a nullable ready marker. Body/hash computation is Go/UDF-bound as selected.

T3 Only after admission: actual existing Goal/Task CANCEL operations and fence/drop producers; create control REQUESTED row whose complete task set equals ADMITTED. Newly created legitimate noRun Session fence must reference original no-fence admission and actual same-tx creation; unowned Task without Session gets no invented generation. No provider/budget operation.

T4 Build candidate original response after mutations. For ACK: full frozen validation, control.original_response one-time bytes, sole idempotency INSERT with actual private header; SQL requires matching ADMITTED group. Deferred FKs force original locator/identity by commit. No published response before outer commit. Typed rejection rolls back business savepoint including all admission/control mutations, preserves only the new identity+journal rejection as handler requires.

T5 Immediate COMPLETED is a distinct ORIGINAL_COMPLETED shape, not synthetic ACK. Prepare genuine settlement and final snapshot in same Tx, validate it; stage identical original_response/final_response in control, append exact FINALIZED group against ADMITTED and real anchors, set CONFIRMED, INSERT original completed journal. Deferred final journal link allows this order; final INSERT must require complete final group. Snapshot computation must exclude only this actually-to-be-confirmed pending ID; no global pending suppression.

T6 Existing ACK replay: reread original identity/header/request from sole row, byte-check old ACK against retained original, validate all exact original members and current finalization anchors. Compute full final response, single-assign control.final_response, append FINALIZED all members, change REQUESTED->CONFIRMED, UPDATE original journal body WHERE all locator/hash AND body=old raw with RowsAffected=1. SQL revalidates full group/anchors and body contract. All within caller Tx; errors roll back every stage. Replay after success only reads original journal, never control fallback.

T7 Root/member witnesses or staged final response alone are not completed authority. Any partial committed raw construction must fail backup/read closure and cannot satisfy final journal guard. The design must demonstrate all insertion cycles with actual deferred constraints and raw SQL controls before SOURCE_READY; no committed flags grant transition.
